QUOTE: "It is used when there is no `index_scope:`, or when the declared one is rejected." and "`.clew.yaml` ... may carry an `index_scope:` ... If nothing usable is declared, the whole repository becomes the scope"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a declared index_scope is tried first and that both absence and rejection of it fall through to whole-repo indexing.
